entries.title: Adding an article offers a public copy first
entries.body: When the address you add matches an article another reader has made public, and that copy is ready to read, Spideryarn asks first. You can read the public copy free, or add your own, which uses one of your article slots as usual. The same choice appears when you add an article from a link inside another one, and 'Add a private copy' on a public article goes straight to adding your own.

entries.title: Unconfirmed private links can be turned off
entries.body: If the reply to 'Create the link' never arrived, the Add page offered only 'Check again', so a private link that might be live could not be stopped from there. A 'Turn off' button sits beside it. A link still being created when you press it may switch on afterwards; the tip on the button says so.
